ads.text: Thinking about rooftop solar but not sure whom to trust? Watch this Hyderabad customer share their real experience - from site survey to installation and subsidy guidance. No sales talk. Just facts, uncut customer review. CTA line: 'Real Solar Experience uncut - Hyderabad | uncut Customer review | Rooftop solar | Subsidy support'.

ad_library.summary: mrsolar.in has exactly one active Meta ad - a Hyderabad customer-review video that has been running since 5 May 2026, over five months on the same creative. The click goes to an fb.me link, not to a specific page on mrsolar.in. The site itself (fetched 2026-10-22) is the fullest asset in this batch: an ISO 9001:2015 badge, PM Surya Ghar subsidy content including the Rs 78,000 central subsidy and 300 free units, a savings calculator, an eligibility form, a WhatsApp button (wa.me/918500911912) and city pages for Hyderabad plus seven other Telangana towns. None of that machinery is referenced by the ad copy beyond a passing 'subsidy guidance'.

funnel.destination: fb.me 'Book now' - Facebook's link wrapper, not a page on mrsolar.in
funnel.meaning: The only live ad sends its click through an fb.me wrapper instead of to the subsidy page, calculator or eligibility form that already exist on mrsolar.in. After five months on one creative there is no second angle, no retargeting creative and no owned page behind the spend.

findings: One live ad, running since 5 May 2026 - over five months on a single customer-review video with no second creative angle behind it.

The ad's click goes to an fb.me wrapper, while mrsolar.in already has the landing assets a subsidy-motivated click wants: the PM Surya Ghar Rs 78,000 subsidy page, the savings calculator and the eligibility form.

The site positions itself as an 'unbiased consumer reviews of Telangana & AP solar companies' destination with an ISO 9001:2015 badge and city pages for Hyderabad, Karimnagar, Warangal, Siddipet, Nalgonda, Rangareddy, Medchal and Malkajgiri - a trust story the one ad never tells.

Contact paths on the live site are split three ways: the contact page lists info@mrsolar.in and contact@mrsolar.in with +91 8500225885, while the floating WhatsApp button uses a different number, +91 85009 11912.
next_steps: Point the ad at the subsidy page

The video promises 'subsidy guidance' - send the click to the PM Surya Ghar Rs 78,000 page with the calculator and eligibility form on it, so five months of spend finally lands on the page built to convert it.
One testimonial video for five months is the whole account. A calculator-led or eligibility-check creative gives the same audience a different door in.
info@mrsolar.in / contact@mrsolar.in / +91 8500225885 on the contact page against +91 85009 11912 on the WhatsApp button - one enquiry path, one number.
contact_facts: ISO 9001:2015; PM Surya Ghar Rs 78,000 subsidy + 300 free units content; savings calculator; city pages for Hyderabad and 7 other Telangana towns

controls.name: Meta Pixel installed
controls.evidence: Landing page was not source-checked for this report; needs a page-source pull or account access.

controls.name: UTM parameters on ad destinations
controls.evidence: Live ads click to a Facebook lead form (fb.me) - traffic never reaches a page you own, so no URL can carry UTMs and click data stays inside Meta.

controls.name: Domain verification
controls.evidence: Business Manager domain verification cannot be observed from public ad data; needs account access.

controls.name: Creative format diversity
controls.evidence: Ad-card formats were not captured for these ads.

controls.name: Creative concept coverage
controls.evidence: Only 2 offer angle in live copy (government subsidy, installation speed) - every ad says the same thing.

controls.name: Social proof utilization
controls.evidence: No social proof (customer counts, reviews, testimonials) in the live ad copy.

controls.name: Video aspect ratios
controls.evidence: Creative files cannot be downloaded from the Ad Library; needs account access or the raw creatives.

controls.name: UGC / social-native content
controls.evidence: Content style cannot be verified from ad cards alone.

controls.name: CTR benchmark
controls.evidence: No spend or impression data is public for this advertiser; the catalog forbids benchmark guessing.

controls.name: Creative freshness
controls.evidence: Live creatives include recent launches (newest started May 5, 2026) - the account is not running one stale ad forever.

controls.name: Campaign fragmentation
controls.evidence: A single live ad - no internal comparison, no safety net if it fatigues.

controls.name: Campaign objective alignment
controls.evidence: Ad CTA and destination agree on one job: fb.me link wrapper.

controls.name: Creative fatigue detection
controls.evidence: Frequency and performance decay need account metrics.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
